verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials is a fair axis for an observability platform, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers API keys, role-based privileges, or credential scoping. 'Elastic Agent' and Fleet refer to telemetry-collection agents, not credentials for AI agents, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
